_note: The identity of the Path of Building (PoE2) working tree that PoE2 oracle dumps are generated from and that every //pob2: citation resolves against. Verified by `task pob-pin GAME=poe2`. content_sha256 is the ASSERTION and covers the working-tree bytes of every git-tracked file under `scope`. `sha` and `describe` are ADVISORY: the fork commits are fork-local, so a fresh clone replaying them as patches has identical content under different commit objects.
scope_note: src/ is the calculation. runtime/lua/ holds the vendored xml/dkjson/sha1 libraries the dumper loads over LUA_PATH, so it is load-bearing for the oracle too. Tracked files only.
